text: The Manager, Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit, Social Development, Finance and Administration, will give a presentation on the role of the Partnership and Accountability Circle. The Memorandum of Understanding outlines the relationship and distinctions between the mandates, scope, and purposes of the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit's Partnership and Accountability Circle and the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee. It also outlines a series of principles and considerations to underscore an effective working relationship between the two bodies.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
